title: kb_backlog usage gives every backlog.py command a line, begin and runner included
goal: kb_backlog usage with no argument prints a one-line description for every command the backlog.py parser offers

run:
import sys, argparse
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
import backlog, bl_cli, kb_mcp
backlog.load_settings(bl_cli.default_root(backlog.ROOT))
ap = bl_cli.build_parser(backlog.__doc__.split("\n\n")[0], backlog.ROOT)
verbs = next(a.choices for a in ap._actions if isinstance(a, argparse._SubParsersAction))
missing = [v for v in verbs if not kb_mcp.BACKLOG_VERB_LINES.get(v)]
print("no line:", missing)
sys.exit(1 if missing else 0)

notes: Plan 2026-10-25, added to SP-lhpvwh6l at the manager's ask. Premise: the check prints the verbs without a BACKLOG_VERB_LINES entry on today's base (begin, runner among them). Ordered after BG-54tplq4n: both change _tools/kb_mcp.py.
